mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_skill_create_receipts(request_id,tenant_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{tenant},#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_skill_create_receipts SET definition_id=#{definition},draft_id=#{draft},draft_revision=#{revision} WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND draft_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,definition_id::text AS definition_id, draft_id::text AS draft_id,draft_revision AS revision FROM nw_skill_create_receipts WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
